clean.text: Michael Jobe filed a Trailer Inspection Form for trailer 602 and the Cass Countiss 20E 5H air job (36221) with a fully completed OWL close-out, all photos same-day. Brianda Sandoval filed a Trailer Inspection Form and the Turner E2-1202C 103H air job (36236_1), close-out complete. Jordan Lemmons filed two Trailer Inspection Forms for trailer 605, both with same-day photo sets throughout. Kedrick McCarter's Scarlet Unit 2 2927SH air job (36241_2) is complete. Robert Henigan filed the Turner air job (36236_2) and a Trailer Readiness Form with all ten bottle entries correctly recorded. Larry Taylor's Comstock inspection daily is clean once the AT# "N/A" exemption is applied. Bobby Fleming's Commuting Journey Management Plan is fully completed with a same-day signature. Nathan Contreras's Trailer Inspection Form for trailer 139 is clean, though it carries a 10/23 form date.

Trailer forms of both kinds and the equipment sections of the H2S daily are photo-based, so a defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside images, not as text, so the only thing I can check on those is whether the photograph was taken on the day. A second limitation applies tonight in particular: this review runs at 11:00 PM Central, before the day has closed, so the usual sweep of the following morning for late-arriving submissions could not be run. Any 10/24 form that lands after 11:00 PM tonight or on Sunday morning is not in these counts, and some of the gaps listed above may close that way.

34 of 34 submissions read — 31 carrying 10/24 form dates and 3 carrying 10/23 form dates. Both job boards were available: Blake Walton's 10/24/2026 email, using the "10-24" sheet on each workbook. 31 manned board rows were checked for coverage, 20 on the Permian Basin board and 11 on the ArkLaTex board, of which 9 were marked ON STANDBY and are not assignments. Note that 31 submissions is below the usual 45 to 70 per day; Saturdays run lighter, and the boards show 9 standby rows and a large days-off roster, which is consistent with the volume.
